svg.title: Rehearse the minute GNSS goes dark.
svg.desc: Rehearse the minute GNSS goes dark. Kshana's mission console, drawn from a real run of engine v0.31.0: the chained campaign campaign-jam-spoof-holdover-integrity (seed 20260928, 6 phases, 18 member runs over T+01:16:10) and the 102 satellites of GPS, Galileo, BeiDou and GLONASS from constellation-multi-gnss-coverage, each drawn on the circular two-body orbit recovered from the engine's ground track, radii compressed for display. Clock time error peaks at 62.7 ns against a 50 ns guard, carrier-to-noise density falls to -12.2 dB-Hz against a 25 dB-Hz floor, and the vertical protection level reaches 135.4 m against a 50 m alert limit.
